slides.say: An Effect that animates something in should reset it in the cleanup.
Set opacity to one to trigger the animation. In the cleanup, put it back to zero.

slides.text: Dev: 1 → 0 → 1. Looks the same as going straight to 1.
slides.say: In development, opacity goes one, zero, one. To the user, it looks the same as setting one once.

slides.text: Animation library? Reset its timeline in cleanup.
slides.say: Using an animation library with tweening? Reset its timeline to the start in the cleanup.
